Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Gate. Case: normal use - closing the release. The proof is recorded here and in a commit that changes only this `.factory` record, but `src/forge/review.py:691-700` skips bookkeeping-only commits when collecting the proof list. The release code commit has no proof paragraph, so Forge supplies `missing` to the review and cannot attach test results to the named checks. This is new evidence not accounted for by the coordinator's instruction to record the list in the fix record. Put the same proof in a commit message Forge will read, without changing code.
